name: Alex's Reader
subtitle: One app, kept fresh.
description: The private build of Reader, published for the people it was made for.

apps.name: Reader
apps.subtitle: Books, catalogs, and volume-key page turns.
apps.localizedDescription: A personal e-book reader. Reads EPUB, FB2, MOBI, AZW3 and CBZ, pulls books from any OPDS catalog, and turns pages with a swipe, a tap or the hardware volume keys. The page is set like a printed one: a running head, a text block and a folio, in six themes.

versions.localizedDescription:
Tap a picture in a book to open it full screen — pinch or double-tap for a closer look.
Tap the small number beside a word to read its note, and the button in the corner brings you back to the page you were on.

A proper app icon — a walnut page, instead of the blue placeholder.
Nothing else in the app has changed.
fix(reader): folio stability, paging with the chrome up, and a shelf that finds Cyrillic (#4)
